units.source_text: 不仅仅是这样，他最憎恨的也是初中时候的老师。

en.t: Not only that, the people he hated most were also his middle school teachers.

units.source_text: 身为一个普通人的老师肯定不是个坏人。

en.t: As ordinary people, those teachers surely were not bad people.

units.source_text: 但是，由于他们承担“教育责任”——尤其是有权利处罚学生，自然他们就会成为暴君。

en.t: But because they bore an educational responsibility, and especially because they had the power to punish students, they naturally became tyrants.

units.source_text: 他们为了将自己的偏见灌输到学生里心里，不择手段。

en.t: They stopped at nothing to instill their own prejudices into the hearts of their students.

units.source_text: 其中一个外号叫“达摩”的英语老师，常常以信辅“傲慢”的理由惩罚他。

en.t: One of them, an English teacher nicknamed Daruma, often punished Shinsuke on the grounds that he was arrogant.

units.source_text: 但是，信辅之所以被认为“傲慢”，竟然是因为他阅读国木田独步和田山花袋的书。

en.t: But the reason Shinsuke was considered arrogant was, astonishingly, that he read books by Kunikida Doppo and Tayama Katai.

units.source_text: 还有一个左眼装的是义眼的国语老师，以信辅不喜欢武术和运动比赛的理由而看不起他。

en.t: There was also a Japanese language teacher with an artificial left eye who looked down on Shinsuke because he disliked martial arts and athletic competitions.

units.source_text: 曾经数次讽刺信辅：“你是个女人吗？”

en.t: Several times he mocked Shinsuke, saying, Are you a woman?

units.source_text: 信辅反问他：“你是个男人吗？”

en.t: Shinsuke asked him back, Are you a man?

units.source_text: 老师对他这种傲慢的态度当然会惩罚。

en.t: Naturally, the teacher punished him for such an arrogant attitude.

units.source_text: 其他事情，只要重新读一遍那本《不自欺记》，就能知道他所遭受的屈辱不胜其数。

en.t: As for the rest, one need only reread that book, A Record of Not Deceiving Myself, to know that the humiliations he suffered were beyond counting.

units.source_text: 信辅自尊心很强，为了争一口气，不得不反抗这种屈辱。

en.t: Shinsuke had a strong sense of pride, and to preserve his dignity he had no choice but to resist such humiliation.

units.source_text: 如果他不如此反抗的话，他也许会像不良少年般不屑自己。

en.t: If he had not resisted in this way, he might have come to despise himself like a delinquent youth.

units.source_text: 他的自强之道，无疑可以在《不自欺记》中找到——

en.t: His path of self-strengthening can undoubtedly be found in A Record of Not Deceiving Myself.
